top_current_affairs.title: India-Iran 10-Year Long-Term Contract on Chabahar Port Operation
top_current_affairs.summary: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) signed a 10-year contract with Iran's Ports and Maritime Organization to operate the Shahid Beheshti terminal at Chabahar Port, boosting regional connectivity and trade bypassing Pakistan.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Key for questions on India's 'Connect Central Asia' policy, INSTC (International North-South Transport Corridor), and strategic diplomacy in Western Asia.

top_current_affairs.title: RBI Approves Record ₹2.11 Lakh Crore Surplus Transfer to Central Government
top_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved a surplus transfer of ₹2,10,874 crore to the Union Government for FY 2023-24 under the Economic Capital Framework (ECF) recommended by the Bimal Jalan Committee.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Important for understanding fiscal deficit management, RBI's capital reserve framework, non-tax revenue sources, and macroeconomic stability.

top_current_affairs.title: Severe Heatwave Conditions and Urban Heat Island (UHI) Effect Across Northern India
top_current_affairs.summary: IMD issued red alerts for multiple northern states due to extreme heatwaves amplified by climate change, deforestation, and the Urban Heat Island effect in metropolitan regions.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Relevant for topics on Disaster Management, Climate Change adaptation, IMD heatwave criteria, and urban planning challenges.

top_current_affairs.title: ISRO Successfully Tests 3D-Printed Liquid Rocket Engine (PSQA)
top_current_affairs.summary: ISRO achieved a major milestone by successfully testing a 3D-printed liquid rocket engine (PS4 engine for PSLV), reducing manufacturing lead time by 60% and raw material usage by 50%.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: High probability topic for Prelims and Mains regarding additive manufacturing (3D printing), space technology cost-efficiency, and indigenous innovation.

top_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Arrest Powers under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court clarified that once a trial court takes cognizance of a complaint under PMLA, the Enforcement Directorate (ED) cannot arrest the accused without obtaining a warrant from the court.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Crucial for questions on Fundamental Rights (Article 21), power dynamics of statutory investigation agencies, and judicial review.
